race.comment: FLYING CAPITAL (5) is building towards his maiden success, the latest effort a solid second over 1500m at this track, beaten 0.8 lengths after he worked home well. He should get every hope from the soft gate with Meech on and looks a huge chance. JUST SWIFT (11) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten narrowly when fourth in a 1620m contest at Donald last start. Off a freshen here but has claims in yet another one where plenty of contenders have come out. DUPEROUZEL (2) made sharp improvement at start two onto this surface and should set up nicely here from a good gate. BOULDEROO (1) is knocking on the door and should be thereabouts again.
